scenarios.top_level_prompt: In the OpenClaw repo, investigate issue #10864 about orphan openclaw-completion processes, isolate the most likely cleanup boundary, propose the smallest viable fix or guard, define a focused regression validation path, and return a final reviewer verdict on whether the plan is credible.

agents.name: scout
agents.goal: Identify the cleanup boundary and the smallest set of target files.

toolset.name: broad-repo-scan
toolset.description: Broad repo scan for issue-related terms across docs, scripts, src, and tests.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "openclaw-completion|orphan|background process|child-process bridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|spawn\(" docs scripts src test | sed -n '1,180p'

toolset.name: read-background-doc
toolset.description: Read the background process doc that explains child-process bridge expectations.

toolset.name: read-recovery-script
toolset.description: Read the orphan recovery script used by the repo for diagnosis.

toolset.name: read-entry
toolset.description: Read the CLI entry respawn path.

agents.name: fixer
agents.goal: Propose the smallest viable fix or guard using the scout handoff instead of rediscovering the repo.

toolset.name: broad-repo-scan
toolset.description: Broad repo scan for process lifecycle references.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|spawn\(|recover-orphaned|background process" src scripts docs | sed -n '1,180p'

toolset.name: read-entry
toolset.description: Read the entry wrapper where child-process bridge is attached.

toolset.name: read-node-invoke
toolset.description: Read the node-host invoke path where spawned processes are managed.

agents.name: validator
agents.goal: Define a focused regression validation path without broad test sweeps.

toolset.name: broad-validation-scan
toolset.description: Broad validation scan across process cleanup references.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "SIGTERM|SIGKILL|attachChildProcessBridge|orphan|background process" docs/gateway/background-process.md scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'

toolset.name: focused-validation-scan
toolset.description: Focused validation scan over the likely cleanup boundary and stale pid helpers.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|orphan" src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,200p'

toolset.name: read-restart-stale-test
toolset.description: Read stale pid tests to anchor a regression path.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.goal: Review whether the plan is credible, targets the right boundary, and uses focused validation.

toolset.name: focused-validation-scan
toolset.description: Read the focused validation scan for reviewer confirmation.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|orphan" src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,200p'

scout.context_text: Start with docs/gateway/background-process.md and scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh, then confirm the boundary in src/entry.ts and src/node-host/invoke.ts. Avoid broad rediscovery.

fixer.context_text: Use the scout handoff. Stay on src/entry.ts and src/node-host/invoke.ts. Do not restart repo-wide search.

validator.context_text: Use the fixer handoff. Focus on recover-orphaned-processes and stale-pid validation. Avoid broad validation scans.

reviewer.context_text: Review only whether the boundary and validation are credible. Prefer reading the prior artifacts over rediscovery.
